exact_content_address.quality: bit-identical decoded video and audio for all three aliases

edited_condition.reason: The complete dependency key includes condition, latent and noise hashes; changing the condition vector changes the key.

cache_levels.L0_content_package: validated and reusable across package aliases after canonicalization
cache_levels.L1_prompt_encoder: validated by replaying saved condition packages without executing or transmitting the original prompt
cache_levels.L2_H3_attention_or_block: not available: H3 recomputes joint full-sequence attention in every block and step; no KV cache exists, and a correct key must miss after a condition edit

conclusion: Exact repeats can be made very fast, but vector-edited variants cannot safely inherit H3 layer results. Same-GPU batching still saves model residency and scheduling overhead, not semantic-cache computation.
